summary: R4 Retur & Refunds with Supplier RMA lifecycle - Comprehensive testing completed. All backend APIs (73/73 tests) and frontend features verified successfully.
passed_tests: Backend: Login and authentication (admin@kainnusantara.id)
Backend: Chain Sales Return → Purchase Return (create-purchase-return endpoint)
Backend: PR supplier_flow=true, supplier_status=requested_supplier
Backend: PR origin_sales_return_id linked (2-way linking)
Backend: SR linked_purchase_return_id (2-way link verified)
Backend: RMA Approve (gate) - status=approved, stock NOT adjusted, no debit note
Backend: RMA Ship to Supplier - supplier_status=shipped_supplier
Backend: RMA Supplier Accept - supplier_status=accepted_supplier, debit note issued (DN-00003), stock adjusted
Backend: Roll status changed to returned_supplier after accept
Backend: Supplier Reject - supplier_status=rejected_supplier
Backend: Goods Back with Regrade - supplier_status=goods_back, NO debit note
Backend: Roll returned to available status with grade B (regraded from A)
Backend: Import Policy (§J) - Import supplier with returnable_to_supplier=false blocks PR creation (400)
Backend: Import Policy Bypass - bypass_import_policy=true allows PR creation (200)
Backend: Direct PR Flow - approve immediately finalizes (status=approved, debit note issued, stock adjusted)
Backend: Direct PR supplier_status=accepted_supplier
Backend: Guard - Cannot accept before ship (400)
Backend: Guard - Cannot goods-back before reject (400)
Backend: Dashboard Integrity - available_qty matches inventory balances (4167.00)
Frontend: Navigation to Retur Beli (Purchase Returns) page
Frontend: Purchase Returns list displays correctly with 14 PR rows

Frontend: Origin chips displayed (8 chips showing '↩ SRET-xxxxx' for chained PRs)

Frontend: RMA actions block present with ship button
Frontend: Navigation to Retur Jual (Sales Returns) page
Frontend: Sales Returns list displays correctly with 45 SR rows
Frontend: Quarantine panel accessible from settled returns
Frontend: All UI elements render correctly with proper styling
